scope: Three source-code root causes only; generated artifacts and unrelated existing work untouched.

rootCauses.name: Shopify checkout failure recovery
rootCauses.impact: A rejected checkout request permanently disabled the checkout button until reload. Shoppers could not retry.
rootCauses.fix: Catch the failure, show an accessible error, clear pending state in finally, clear stale error on retry. Preserve existing empty-cart disable condition.
rootCauses.tests: Both real component surfaces: deferred request disables button, rejection re-enables it with an alert, second successful request clears alert.

rootCauses.name: Account mutation failure recovery
rootCauses.impact: Token errors could leave account update/delete controls disabled. Failed deletion reloaded the page, concealing failure. HTTP error responses were treated as success.
rootCauses.fix: Shared request handler catches token/network failures, checks HTTP success, always resets busy state in finally; reload only after confirmed successful deletion. English/German visible failure messages.
rootCauses.tests: Both update and delete: deferred token rejection, HTTP 503, then HTTP 204 success; failed delete never reloads, successful delete does.

rootCauses.name: Dialog route subscription leak
rootCauses.impact: Cleanup registered another route-error listener instead of releasing it, retaining stale component closures across navigation. Strict Mode duplicates the handler immediately.
rootCauses.fix: Unsubscribe the exact route-error handler with events.off, matching route-complete cleanup.
rootCauses.tests: Regression test failed before fix (two listeners instead of one), passes after; three Strict Mode mount/unmount cycles, both events still close an open dialog, zero listeners remain after unmount.

grouping: No fixGroupId on selected findings. Two checkout sites are one duplicated behavior; two account operations share one request-state root cause; dialog cleanup is independent. Five original findings addressed.
recipeFetch: curl with Cache-Control: no-cache and Pragma: no-cache; validation and fix prompts reviewed before editing.
